positions.question: Do you support the forgiveness of federal student loan debt?

evidence.text: "Biden's ridiculous student loan forgiveness proposal was always unconstitutional. Even Nancy Pelosi agreed. I’m glad to see #SCOTUS reject Biden’s vote-buying scheme."
"President Biden’s student loan bailout will cost American taxpayers roughly $500 BILLION over the next 10 years."

positions.question: Do you support requiring a government-issued identification in order to vote at the polls?

evidence.text: "67% of Americans support voter ID. With Republicans in charge, our election laws will be more secure."

"Our Constitution grants state legislatures the primary role in establishing election law and administering elections, but H.R. 1 upends that constitutional balance by undermining voter ID laws, forcing states to permanently expand mail-in voting, legalizing ballot harvesting, and stealing federal funding from crime victims to divert it to political campaigns. Additionally, this bill stifles free speech by empowering President Biden's IRS to target conservative organizations and deny them tax-exempt status, and increases our vulnerability for foreign election interference at a time when we should be increasingly vigilant about hostile regimes seeking to undermine our democracy."

"The Heroes Act is a mess. Dems are trying to force a federal takeover of our election system. They want mail-in voting, same day voter registration & they even want to prevent states from enforcing voter ID laws."
Voted against HR 5746 "Freedom to Vote: John R. Lewis Act"

positions.question: Do you support increasing security along the southern US border?

evidence.text: "In Congress, I will fight to secure our border and reform our outdated immigration system to stop the flow of drugs and opioids, crackdown on child sex trafficking, end sanctuary cities nationwide, and protect the jobs and wages of American workers."

"It is just not fentanyl. Let's talk about the crisis of immigration. Since Biden took office, over 3.5 million illegal immigrants have been apprehended at the southern border. This CR does nothing to add additional border security; nothing for additional infrastructure; nothing for advanced technology."

"When the Trump Administration left office, and President Biden entered the Oval Office, illegal immigration was at record lows, inflation was close to zero, and our foreign adversaries feared the United States. Three years later, America is witnessing record-high illegal border crossings, record-high price increases, and a world that is on fire. It didn’t have to be this way. Joe Biden and his radical Democrats worked to destroy our nation and the American Dream. The State of our Union can only be strong when our leaders fight for the American people — not themselves and their donors."
